name: black_ledger_financial_v1
precondition: Confirmed intended project and exact new-object names unchanged; execute as an atomic migration. Stop on unexpected existing objects, permission rejection or any partial/unknown result. No automatic retry.
security: Existing auth.uid() and current admin_members only. Private RLS SELECT for Admin records/revisions. No direct financial table writes, receipt enumeration, anonymous or service-role execute grant. Helpers are not client callable.
prohibitedSideEffects: No updates to original Orders, Inventory or payments.
No fulfilment mutation, refunds, stock writer, email enqueue/send or catalogue generation.

tested.migrationFailureRollback: PASS in isolated PostgreSQL17.6 and PGlite

rollback.action: Revoke authenticated execution of new save RPC and deploy disabled financial flag. Preserve all recorded financial inputs, revisions, receipts and Admin reads. No DROP or deletion of financial history.

controlledAcceptance.allowed: Only a clearly designated existing noncustomer external test order. Actual normal Admin session, save/reload of explicitly labelled test inputs, conflict/receipt checks only as necessary.
controlledAcceptance.forbidden: No fictitious economics on a real customer order. No production test-order creation, stock deduction, payment or message is included in this migration approval.
controlledAcceptance.activation: Keep financeActivation disabled until this exact database gate and controlled authenticated acceptance pass. The initial controlled UI stage must be restricted to the designated test order; it must not invent a livePersistenceEvidenceSHA256.

separateFrontendPublicationGate: Automatic approval review rejected main update for AUTHORISATION63 attachment-only authority. Direct typed owner confirmation for63 frontend publication is required; no retry or alternate route has been attempted.
